description: Existing lint, typecheck and smoke pass before CLI work starts
steps: OUT=$(mktemp -d) pnpm smoke exits 0 and writes screeny-*.png

description: render.ts loads fonts and bezels from a configurable PUBLIC_DIR instead of process.cwd()
steps: PUBLIC_DIR honours SCREENY_PUBLIC_DIR and defaults to <cwd>/public

description: pnpm build:cli bundles src/cli into a single ESM file dist-cli/screeny.js
steps: dist-cli/screeny.js exists and is the only JS output
dependencies are external (bundle does not inline satori, libsql, resvg, sharp)

description: Bundle aliases server-only to an empty module without editing service/render/storage/api
steps: git diff shows no removal of server-only imports in src/lib
node dist-cli/screeny.js --version does not throw the server-only error

description: @/ imports resolve inside the bundle
steps: running any data command loads the service layer without module-not-found

description: dist-cli is gitignored and excluded from eslint
steps: git status after build shows no dist-cli files
pnpm lint passes with dist-cli present

description: --version, -v and version print the bare package.json version
steps: output has no prefix or extra lines

description: No-arg invocation with an empty data dir prints the AXI home view
steps: run with temp SCREENY_DATA_DIR and no args
output has bin: and description: lines
output has an explicit no projects line

description: Home view lists projects with slug and screens count
steps: output lists demo with screens count 0

description: Home view supports --json
steps: stdout parses as JSON with bin, description, projects, help

description: Unknown command is a usage error with help
steps: stdout contains error: naming nope and a help: line

description: Unknown flags are rejected by name
Missing required argument is a usage error
steps: run screeny new with no name
error: and help: lines on stdout

description: Errors with --json print {error, help} on stdout
steps: stdout parses as JSON with error and help keys

description: Runtime failures exit 1 with error and help
steps: stdout has error: about the project and a help: line

description: No command ever waits for stdin input (except mcp)
steps: run every non-mcp command with stdin closed

description: screeny projects lists projects
steps: empty data dir: prints a no projects line, exit 0
after creating two projects: both slugs listed with screens counts

description: screeny new <name> creates a project
Creating an existing project reports it and exits 0
steps: second run says it already exists and exits 0

description: screeny add-image <project> <file> stores a screenshot asset
steps: create a small PNG in a temp dir

description: add-image fails cleanly on missing file or project
steps: missing file path: error + help, exit 1

description: screeny generate <project> --spec <file.json> runs generateScreens
steps: write a spec with device iphone-6.9, locale en, two text screens

description: Invalid specs are rejected via generateSchema
steps: spec with unknown template: error naming the field, exit 2
spec file that is not JSON: error, exit 2

description: Spec can reference an asset added by add-image
steps: generate a hero screen referencing the asset url
render produces a PNG larger than the text-only one

description: Spec with locales and localized titles creates screens per locale
steps: spec with locales [en, tr] and {en,tr} title maps
generate creates screens for both locales
Turkish title renders without missing glyph errors

description: screeny render <project> --out <dir> writes PNGs
steps: each file starts with the PNG signature 89 50 4E 47
each file is larger than 10 KB

description: render honours --locale and --device filters
steps: render --locale tr writes only tr files
render --device iphone-6.9 writes only that device
a filter matching nothing is an error with help

description: render without --out is a usage error
CLI renders from a cwd outside the repo, fonts resolved from the repo
steps: no ./public or ./data created in the temp cwd when SCREENY_DATA_DIR is set

description: screeny export <project> --apple --out <dir> writes the App Store zip
export rejects missing --apple and empty projects
steps: export demo --out <tmp> without --apple: exit 2 with help
export on a project with no screens: error No screens to export, exit 1

description: All CLI runs in tests use a temp SCREENY_DATA_DIR
steps: every spawn in test/cli.test.mjs sets SCREENY_DATA_DIR to a mkdtemp dir

description: MCP tool registrations live in a shared module used by the HTTP route
steps: src/app/api/mcp/route.ts calls it and still exists
tool names match the previous list (list_meta ... export_creative)

description: screeny mcp answers initialize over stdio
tools/list over stdio returns the shared tools with strict schemas
A tool call over stdio works against the temp data dir
mcp mode writes only JSON-RPC to stdout
steps: every stdout line parses as JSON
logs, if any, go to stderr

description: skills/screeny/SKILL.md is the canonical agent skill
steps: file has frontmatter name and one-line description
documents every command, --json and the MCP alternative

description: screeny skill prints the embedded SKILL.md
steps: run screeny skill from a temp cwd
works without the skills dir present at runtime (embedded at build)

description: screeny skill install --dir d writes SKILL.md idempotently
steps: second run reports already installed, exit 0
modified file without --force is reported and left untouched

description: pnpm test:cli builds and runs node:test over test/*.test.mjs
steps: package.json test:cli runs build:cli then node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
suite covers home, version, usage errors, generate+render PNGs, apple zip, MCP stdio

description: README has a CLI and MCP section
steps: README contains a CLI and MCP heading
shows build:cli, a new/generate/render example, screeny mcp registration and skill install

description: docs/agent/verify.sh exits 0
